newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH HOTLINE TO BOOST JEWISH ETHNIC AWARENESS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH HOTLINE TO BOOST JEWISH ETHNIC AWARENESS.

text.p: A telephone hotline has been set up in Warsaw to increase Jewish ethnic awareness, the project's head said on Sunday.

"In Poland there are thousands of people of Jewish ancestry who come from assimilated families and know very little about their heritage," Stanislaw Krajewski, chairman of the new Jewish Forum volunteer group, told Reuters.
"The purpose of our Jewish confidential telephone line is to enhance such people's cultural awareness."
Krajewski said the initiative was launched by some eight Poles of Jewish ancestry, including psychologists and educators.
People phoning 652-2144 on Thursdays from 1730 to 2000 local (1630 - 1900 GMT) receive information about Jewish organisations, study groups and other activities.
"Some callers merely want to talk, others request specific information," Krajewski added.
The Jewish Forum, which sponsors the hotline, seeks to "improve the quality of Jewish life in Poland."
Krajewski said he did not know exactly how many people of Jewish or part-Jewish descent were now living in Poland, since many had become fully assimilated and did not identify with their ancestry.
Only a few thousand people who consider themselves Jews remain in Poland, most of them elderly.
Before World War Two there were some 3.5 million Jews in the country, about 10 percent the population.
About 90 percent of them were killed in the Holocaust by the Nazi German invaders.
